# grove add: PR GitHub CLI arguments and failures are tested offline

setup_workspace feature-pr numeric-pr

# A numeric fork PR resolves its base repository from the GitHub origin,
# then fetches the branch from a local fixture.
exec git -C $WORK/workspace/.bare remote set-url origin https://github.com/acme/widgets
env FAKE_GH_LOG=$WORK/gh.log
env FAKE_GH_PR_VIEW=$WORK/numeric-pr.json
env FAKE_GH_REPO_VIEW=$WORK/numeric-url.txt
exec grove add --pr 17
exists ../pr-17

exec grove remove pr-17 --force
exec grove add --switch --pr 17
stdout '^.*[/\\\\]pr-17$'
! stderr 'Created worktree'
exists ../pr-17
exec grove remove pr-17 --force

# gh's unresolved-PR error is mapped to Grove's not-found error.
env FAKE_GH_FAIL='pr view'
env FAKE_GH_STDERR='Could not resolve to a PullRequest'
! exec grove add --pr 99999
stderr 'PR #99999 not found in acme/widgets'

# A numeric PR still requires a GitHub origin.
env FAKE_GH_FAIL=
exec git -C $WORK/workspace/.bare remote set-url origin file://$WORK/testrepo
! exec grove add --pr 123
stderr 'requires workspace context'

# The URL form can fetch entirely from the local workspace remote.
env FAKE_GH_PR_VIEW=$WORK/same-repo-pr.json
exec grove add https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/18
exists ../pr-18
! exec grove add https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/18
stderr 'worktree already exists for branch "feature-pr"'

# A fork PR asks gh for the fork URL before fetching its branch.
mkdir $WORK/fork
exec git -C $WORK/fork init
cp $WORK/fork.txt $WORK/fork/fork.txt
exec git -C $WORK/fork add .
exec git -C $WORK/fork commit -m 'fork commit'
exec git -C $WORK/fork branch -m fork-feature
env FAKE_GH_PR_VIEW=$WORK/fork-pr.json
env FAKE_GH_REPO_VIEW=$WORK/fork-url.txt
exec grove add https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/19
exists ../pr-19/fork.txt

env FAKE_GH_FAIL='repo view'
env FAKE_GH_STDERR='fake repo failure'
! exec grove add https://github.com/acme/widgets/pull/20
stderr 'failed to get repo URL: fake repo failure'

cmpenv $WORK/gh.log $WORK/want-gh.log

-- numeric-pr.json --
{"headRefName":"numeric-pr","headRepository":{"name":"testrepo"},"headRepositoryOwner":{"login":"contrib"}}

-- numeric-url.txt --
file://$WORK/testrepo

-- same-repo-pr.json --
{"headRefName":"feature-pr","headRepository":{"name":"widgets"},"headRepositoryOwner":{"login":"acme"}}

-- fork-pr.json --
{"headRefName":"fork-feature","headRepository":{"name":"fork"},"headRepositoryOwner":{"login":"contrib"}}

-- fork-url.txt --
file://$WORK/fork

-- fork.txt --
fork content

-- want-gh.log --
["auth","status"]
["pr","view","17","--repo","acme/widgets","--json","headRefName,headRepository,headRepositoryOwner"]
["repo","view","contrib/testrepo","--json","url","-q",".url"]
["auth","status"]
["pr","view","17","--repo","acme/widgets","--json","headRefName,headRepository,headRepositoryOwner"]
["auth","status"]
["pr","view","99999","--repo","acme/widgets","--json","headRefName,headRepository,headRepositoryOwner"]
["auth","status"]
["auth","status"]
["pr","view","18","--repo","acme/widgets","--json","headRefName,headRepository,headRepositoryOwner"]
["auth","status"]
["pr","view","18","--repo","acme/widgets","--json","headRefName,headRepository,headRepositoryOwner"]
["auth","status"]
["pr","view","19","--repo","acme/widgets","--json","headRefName,headRepository,headRepositoryOwner"]
["repo","view","contrib/fork","--json","url","-q",".url"]
["auth","status"]
["pr","view","20","--repo","acme/widgets","--json","headRefName,headRepository,headRepositoryOwner"]
["repo","view","contrib/fork","--json","url","-q",".url"]
